code:
docker run -it --rm \
  --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway \
  -v "$PWD:/workspace:rw" \
  -v "$HOME/agents/knowledgebase:/reference:ro" \
  -v pi-config:/home/agent/.config \
  --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges \
  course-pi
description: Single command to build the pi image with tag course-pi from the Dockerfile in current directory.

steps.description: Command: docker build -t course-pi . builds image from current directory.
